generator: item ID is item-%06d; title number is (index * 6364136223846793005 + seed) modulo 97 using UInt64 wrapping arithmetic
duplicates: All occurrences in the large collection and queue deliberately reference one media ID, retaining distinct deterministic occurrence UUIDs.
artwork: Synthetic artwork references only, no image bytes. Artwork decoding/cache stress is assigned to later artwork/performance nodes.
credentials: None; a random-format local Keychain reference and clearly synthetic rejection canaries are used.
cleanup: Every test creates a unique native-music-T03-* temporary directory and removes only that disposable directory after closing stores. Crash workers receive only this directory.
queue_property_cases: Six seeds, eight 128-occurrence shuffled snapshots per seed, with distinct occurrence IDs over three repeated media IDs; every snapshot also gets an injected entry-write rollback.
